decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis has its own page and fits the firm's core energy-data software, and one year of results is too short to fall clearly below aspiration, so slack lets the firm carry it.
The gas tariff comparison is prominently presented and complements the electricity offerings, so there is no evident shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is likely a core revenue product with its own page and strong demand among German energy suppliers.
The energy tariff calculator is only mentioned and overlaps with C, which raises the risk it is consolidated, but it is cheap to keep within a shared platform.
The regional area definition tool underpins the location-based products and has its own page, so dropping it would release few resources.
The site-specific comparison is only mentioned and is somewhat redundant, but its low maintenance cost and uncertain early results favour keeping it for now.
